valuation_route_request.normal_earnings_input_treatment: Use the reported FY2017 attributable-profit figure only as a conditional reference. Exclude the identified disposal and retain unknown component contributions rather than producing a normal-earnings point estimate.
valuation_route_request.owner_cash_input_treatment: Treat operating cash less all long-lived-asset spending as a current capital-allocation and financing-pressure observation only. Economic maintenance capital, growth capital, and component cash responsibility are unknown, so normal owner cash is not point-estimated.
valuation_route_request.permanent_loss_input_treatment: Analyze recurring-loss risk, working-capital absorption and financing pressure, unresolved supply-chain cash economics, and project capital-return risk as conditional or unresolved paths; do not infer a completed loss outcome.
valuation_route_request.route_reasoning: The only primary model role is conditional because the supplied record supports a reported consolidated baseline and identifies a nonrecurring disposal, but not a recurring component-level earnings or normal owner-cash range. The other named routes preserve exclusions, unresolved economics, or scenario treatment rather than supplying a result.

industry_future_thesis.adaptation: FY2017 integrated multimedia around television and display products and established a company to handle non-manufacturing multimedia sales, but the supplied source does not show the resulting unit economics or cash conversion.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: The group is exposed to multimedia domestic and export television/display sales, supply-chain trade in IC components, panels, and metals, and named industrial-park projects; group-level cash conversion and borrowings are therefore material to the enterprise view.
industry_future_thesis.horizon: Post-FY2017 normalization period, assessed only from the supplied FY2015--FY2017 disclosures
industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: UNKNOWN: the supplied source identifies the portfolio and channels but provides no forward industry-demand, pricing, or competitor evidence sufficient to establish a market regime.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: MIXED and not numerically normalizable: FY2017 reported profit includes a disclosed non-continuing disposal-related contribution, while the disclosed post-nonrecurring profit proxy was negative and no component-level recurring margins are supplied.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: Funding and execution risk are conditionally elevated by negative FY2017 operating cash flow, larger working-capital balances, and substantial short-term borrowings; the source does not attribute these exposures to individual components or establish a default outcome.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: The source supports only a conditional transmission: multimedia display, supply-chain trade, and the named projects can affect consolidated results, but missing component profitability and cash-flow attribution prevents identifying which component earns the recurring profit pool.
reversal_observations: A post-cutoff official annual report discloses separate profitability, operating cash flow, working-capital balances, and capital spending for the multimedia and supply-chain components.
A post-cutoff official annual report shows sustained positive operating cash flow without a matching rise in receivables or inventories and explains the associated debt-service capacity.
A post-cutoff official annual report discloses project-level invested capital, cash commitments, funding, and subsequent returns for the named industrial-park projects.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: UNKNOWN: the supplied source does not identify or compare a named rival.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Use only a conditional ordinary-earnings-and-owner-cash route after the reported-profit baseline is reconciled and component cash economics are disclosed; keep disposal, unresolved supply-chain economics, and project-return claims outside that route.

situation_model.summary: The consolidated group reported sharply higher FY2017 revenue and reported profit, but its disclosed recurring-profit proxy remained negative, while operating cash flow turned materially negative alongside higher receivables and inventories. The supplied disclosures describe a multi-component portfolio but do not provide component-level profit, cash, working-capital, or financing allocations.
